N1.s: Az ingyenes %lld hely betelt. Ha a Cutlingban folytatod, feloldhatod, és ez is bekerül a többi közé.
N1.back: The free 5 place filled-up. If the Cutling-in you-continue, unlock-can-you-it, and this too gets-in the others among.
N1.why: Opens with the first batch's 'Az ingyenes %lld hely betelt'; 'bekerül a többi közé' is the everyday way to say a thing joins the rest, so the saved item is promised without a 'we'; 97 of 110.

N2.s: Az ingyenes %lld hely betelt. Nyisd meg a Cutlingot, oldd fel, és menthetsz tovább.
N2.back: The free 5 place filled-up. Open up the Cutling-ACC, unlock-it, and you-can-save further.
N2.why: Here the app cannot be opened for them, so three plain te imperatives say what to do, in the order they will do it; 'menthetsz tovább' is how a speaker says carry on saving; 80 of 90.

N3.why: 'Elmentve' is the word Hungarian apps flash after a save; 'Még 1' is the countdown shape of UI counters ('Még 1 nap'); a verbless second sentence is the only way 'free' fits; exactly 30.

N4.why: The same 'used/total ingyenes hely' pair as S29 on the main screen, so 5/5 reads as full with no suffix on a number; positional placeholders keep used before total; 28 of 30.

N5.s: %1$lld/%2$lld betelt. Oldd fel, és ez is bekerül.
N5.back: 5/5 filled-up. Unlock-it, and this too gets-in.
N5.why: Starting on the number avoids the a/az article that would change with it; 'betelt' as in K1 on the same keyboard; 'ez is bekerül' promises the item they were saving, as N1 and N7 do; 39 of 40.

N6.why: It sits where 'Mentés' usually is, and Hungarian buttons take the -ás/-és action noun; the same word as S15; 8 of 10.

N7.s: Az ingyenes %lld hely betelt. Ha feloldod a Cutlingot, ez is bekerül a többi közé.
N7.back: The free 5 place filled-up. If you-unlock the Cutling-ACC, this too gets-in the others among.
N7.why: Same opening and same 'bekerül a többi közé' as N1, so the Share sheet and Siri say one thing in one way; the 'ha' clause makes unlocking the condition, not an order; 79 of 90.

N8.s: A cutlingod megmarad. Nyisd meg a Cutlingot, oldd fel, és bekerül a többi közé.
N8.back: The cutling-your stays-kept. Open up the Cutling-ACC, unlock-it, and gets-in the others among.
N8.why: 'Megmarad' first, so the person knows nothing is lost before being asked to do anything; possessive 'cutlingod' lower-case for the item, 'Cutlingot' capital for the app, as the first batch writes them; 79 of 80.
